G508.b:

G501.b:
⟪ἀντλέω⟫, -ῶ
(< ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for ⁨שׁאב⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., ⟪to bale out⟫.
⟪2.⟫ Generally, ⟪to draw water⟫: absol., ⟦John 2:8|Jo 2:8⟧ ⟦John 4:15|4:15⟧; ὕδωρ, ⟦John 2:9|Jo 2:9⟧ ⟦John 4:7|4:7⟧ (on its use of the water made wine, v. DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, s.v.; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†

Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G502.b:
*† ⟪ἄντλημα⟫, -τος, τό
(< ἀντλέω),
⟪(a)⟫ prop., ⟪what is drawn⟫ (Diosc.);
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪a vessel to draw with⟫, ⟪a bucket⟫ (Plut.; v. Abbott, Essays, 88): ⟦John 4:11|Jo 4:11⟧.†
a: Essays chiefly on the Original Texts of the Old and New Testaments, by T. K. Abbott. Longmans, 1891

G503.b:
**† ⟪ἀντοφθαλμέω⟫, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wi 12:14*;] ⟪to look in the face⟫, ⟪look straight at⟫ (Polyb.). Metaph., ⟪to face⟫, ⟪withstand⟫ (Wi 12:14, Polyb.): c. dat., ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, ⟪to beat up against the wind⟫ (v. DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦Acts 27:15|Ac 27:15⟧.†
a: Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904

G504.b:
⟪ἄνυδρος⟫, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ), [in LXX for ⁨צִיָּה⁩, ⁨יְשִׁימוֹן⁩ (γῆ ἄ), etc.;] ⟪waterless⟫: τόποι, ⟦Matthew 12:43|Mt 12:43⟧, ⟦Luke 11:24|Lk 11:24⟧; πηγαί, ⟦2 Peter 2:17|II Pe 2:17⟧; νεφέλαι, ⟦Jude 1:12|Ju 12⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G505.b:
** ⟪ἀν-υπόκριτος⟫, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι), [in LXX: Wi 5:18 18:16*;] ⟪unfeigned⟫: ⟦Romans 12:9|Ro 12:9⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 6:6|II Co 6:6⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 1:5|I Ti 1:5⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 1:5|II Ti 1:5⟧, ⟦James 3:17|Ja 3:17⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:22|I Pe 1:22⟧ (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G506.b:
**† ⟪ἀνυπότακτος⟫, -ον
(< ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω), [in Sm.: ⟦1 Samuel 2:12|I Ki 2:12⟧ ⟦1 Samuel 10:27|10:27⟧ (for LXX, λοιμός, ⁨בּני בליעל⁩)*;] of things, ⟪not subject to rule⟫: ⟦Hebrews 2:8|He 2:8⟧; of persons, ⟪unruly⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 1:9|I Ti 1:9⟧, ⟦Titus 1:6|Tit 1:6⟧, ⟦Titus 1:10|10⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G507.b:
⟪ἄνω⟫, adv.

⟪(a)⟫ ⟪up⟫, ⟪upwards⟫: ⟦John 11:41|Jo 11:41⟧, ⟦Hebrews 12:15|He 12:15⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪above⟫ (opp. to κάτω): ⟦Acts 2:19|Ac 2:19⟧; with art. ἡ, ⟦Galatians 4:26|Ga 4:26⟧, ⟦Philippians 3:14|Phl 3:14⟧; τά, ⟦John 8:23|Jo 8:23⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:1|Col 3:1⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:2|2⟧; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), ⟦John 2:7|Jo 2:7⟧ (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G509.b:
⟪ἄνωθεν⟫ adv,
(< ἄνω),
⟪(a)⟫ ⟪from above⟫: ἀπὸ ἄ., ⟦Matthew 27:51|Mt 27:51⟧, ⟦Mark 15:38|Mk 15:38⟧; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., ⟦John 19:28|Jo 19:28⟧; meaning, from heaven: ⟦John 3:31|Jo 3:31⟧ ⟦John 19:11|19:11⟧, ⟦James 1:17|Ja 1:17⟧ ⟦James 3:15|3:15⟧, ⟦James 3:17|17⟧ .
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪from the first⟫, ⟪from the beginning⟫: ⟦Luke 1:3|Lk 1:3⟧, ⟦Acts 26:5|Ac 26:5⟧; whence
⟪(c)⟫ ⟪anew⟫, ⟪again⟫: ⟦John 3:3|Jo 3:3⟧, ⟦John 3:7|7⟧, (so most, but v. Meyer, in l.; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., ⟦Galatians 4:9|Ga 4:9⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†
a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899
Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the N.T., by H. A. W. Meyer. Eng. tr., T. & T. Clark, 1883

G511.b:

G512.b:

G515.b:

⟪(a)⟫ ⟪to deem worthy⟫: c. acc. et inf. (v. MM, VGT, s.v., and cf. κατ-αξιόω), ⟦Luke 7:7|Lk 7:7⟧; id. et gen. rei, ⟦2 Thessalonians 1:11|II Th 1:11⟧; pass. c. gen. rei, ⟦1 Timothy 5:17|I Ti 5:17⟧, ⟦Hebrews 3:3|He 3:3⟧ ⟦Hebrews 10:29|10:29⟧;

G517.b:
⟪ἀόρατος⟫, -ον

G518.b:
⟪ἀπ-αγγέλλω⟫,
